text: Computer Science majors (2024-2025) are required to take 9 hours of major technical electives. In addition to the listed options, any other organized CS 4300-level course may be used (see the course description for specific prerequisites). Students may also use CS 4V98 Undergraduate Research in Computer Science or CS 4399 Senior Honors in Computer Science. Students must consult an Academic Advisor before registering in these options.
